notes.title: Update Announcement on August 2nd
notes.notes: Update announcement on August 2nd: Korean and Russian local languages have been updated and optimized, and some contents have been optimized.

notes.title: Regarding the unresponsive main menu issue and 2K resolution update.
notes.notes:
[olist][*][p]We sincerely apologize that some players using 2K resolution experienced unresponsive main menu buttons upon launch. This issue has been fixed in yesterday's update.[/p][/*][/olist][p]However, we regret to inform affected players that deleting configuration save files may still be required to resolve this problem completely.[/p][p]Solution steps:[/p][olist][*][p]Navigate to:
C:\\Users\\Administrator(your username)\\AppData\\Local\\project_A[/p][/*][*][p]Delete all files in this folder[/p][/*][*][p]Relaunch the game[/p][/*][/olist]
